chapter: Blackbirds, Carmen Jones and the Ziegfeld Follies
title: Refusing offers that would split Buck and Bubbles
summary: He turned down offers, including Porgy and Bess, unless Buck was included, since together they could work when shows could not.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Were there many offers that you were getting?
Oh, I got plenty of offers. But they wanted to break up the act. I didn't want to break the act up. They were going to use me and not use my partner because

of my dancing, you know. No, I don't want that. I had quite a lot of offers without my partner, I wouldn't take them. I had Porgy & Bess without my partner, I wouldn't take that either, unless they took him. No, couldn't see it. 'Cause we could work when the show wouldn't be working. We could go places and work.
Then I went from vaudeville to opera. Getting back to the show, closing "Blackbirds" --
